items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The transcript only contains the interviewer mentioning 'His sister' in relation to Paul L. Howard. The interviewee does not speak or confirm any personal relationship.

ctx.x: His sister and his parents--back on the musicians. And his cousin, Gladys, that played piano. They didn't come here to the coast. That was back in Ohio, all of that was back in Ohio.
